mapper.select: SELECT PLAN_IDX, PLAN_TITLE, END_TO, PLAN_SUB_END, IS_SHARED, IS_ACTIVE, PLAN_IMP, CERT_EXP, REPEAT_DAYS, FIRE_STATE, COLOR FROM PLAN_TABLE WHERE USER_IDX = #{userIdx} AND IS_DELETED = 0 AND IS_COMPLETED = 0 ORDER BY IS_ACTIVE DESC, PLAN_IMP DESC, PLAN_SUB_START IS NULL, PLAN_SUB_START DESC

SELECT PLAN_IDX, PLAN_TITLE, END_TO, PLAN_SUB_END, IS_SHARED, IS_ACTIVE, PLAN_IMP, CERT_EXP, REPEAT_DAYS, FIRE_STATE, COLOR FROM PLAN_TABLE WHERE USER_IDX = #{userIdx} AND IS_DELETED = 0 AND IS_COMPLETED = 0 AND IS_ACTIVE = 1 AND FIND_IN_SET(#{dayOfWeek}, REPEAT_DAYS) > 0 ORDER BY PLAN_IMP DESC, PLAN_SUB_START IS NULL, PLAN_SUB_START DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PLAN_TABLE WHERE USER_IDX = #{userIdx} AND IS_DELETED = 0 AND IS_COMPLETED = 0 AND IS_ACTIVE = 1 AND FIND_IN_SET(#{dayOfWeek}, REPEAT_DAYS) > 0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PLAN_TABLE P WHERE P.USER_IDX = #{userIdx} AND P.IS_DELETED = 0 AND P.IS_COMPLETED = 0 AND P.IS_ACTIVE = 1 AND FIND_IN_SET(#{dayOfWeek}, P.REPEAT_DAYS) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PLAN_ACTIVITY A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ACTIVITY_IDX FROM VERIFY_TABLE WHERE VERIFY_DATE = CURDATE() ) V ON A.ACTIVITY_IDX = V.ACTIVITY_IDX WHERE A.PLAN_IDX = P.PLAN_IDX AND A.IS_DELETED = 0 AND V.ACTIVITY_IDX IS NULL )
